title: Primary site unknown after appropriate search for primary
summary: Primary site unknown after appropriate search for primary - metastatic carcinoma or sarcoma, except for squamous cell carcinoma confined to the neck nodes.

children.criterion: Metastatic carcinoma or sarcoma (documented by biopsy) with primary site unknown after appropriate search. Excludes squamous cell carcinoma confined to the neck nodes.
Not squamous cell carcinoma confined to the neck nodes (those cases are evaluated under 13.02)
